30 sheets. Keep 3.
Suite 200, A-101
Prove the scale.
Box the rooms; the plan names them.
RTU-1: 3,000 CFM, 0.8 in. of static.
The unit, on the roof over the corridor.
A diffuser, 150 CFM.
Three leave the room short.
The fourth turns it green.
Then the rest of the floor.
Trace the main from the unit.
S: the main steps down where a branch leaves.
A branch to each room; the tap counts itself.
The last branch: S sizes it from the air its room needs.
The return: two grilles and a main back to the unit.
One thermostat.
EF-1: the restrooms exhaust on their own fan.
Pounds, not feet: every size, its gauge, its weight.
The fittings counted themselves; the flex is by the drop.
One bid weight.
Bid Check: every room served, inside the unit.
Will it blow? The static path, computed.
The stat is set: one tick the estimator signs.
Nothing missed.
Done.
